title: Iranian Food Composition Table 2017
use_boundary: Request access and reuse permission; use exact food records only after provenance review
notes: Primary Iranian-specific nutrient route; not a recipe-consensus source.

title: SAMAR Iranian food composition data
use_boundary: Request raw data and codebook; do not transcribe reported aggregate claims into production
notes: Reported broad Iranian food/composite coverage requires independent validation.

title: Persian Mama recipe index
use_boundary: Use URLs and independently extracted structured facts only; do not redistribute recipe prose or treat nutrition as authoritative
notes: Broad Persian recipe discovery collection; one publisher/domain is one possible independence group.

title: FAO/USDA Food Composition Tables for the Near East
use_boundary: Use analytical rows only after exact identity/form review and citation; do not bulk redistribute copyrighted tables
notes: Regional analytical candidate with 848 food items; not automatically Iranian-specific.

title: Composition and nutritional value of traditional rural Iranian foods
use_boundary: Use only exact dishes and distinguish collected recipe structure from nutrients calculated using national tables
notes: Covers 24 rural composite dishes; useful for targeted matches rather than blanket coverage.

title: FAO/INFOODS Analytical Food Composition Database 2.0
use_boundary: Use as analytical ingredient gap-fill after identity/form matching; not a source for Iranian recipe identity

title: USDA SR Legacy 2018
use_boundary: Already ingested for generic ingredient nutrient records; exact variant selection still requires review
notes: Do not count as independent Iranian recipe evidence.

title: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023
use_boundary: Already ingested for consumed forms and official portions; do not substitute consumed-food records for recipe evidence
notes: Do not count as independent Iranian recipe evidence.
